sentences.en: The Department of Ethnography was created as a separate deportment within the British Museum in 1946, offer 140 years of gradual development from the original Department of Antiquities.
sentences.zh: 1946年,大英博物馆内单独设立了民族学部,作为驱逐的对象,从原古迹部逐步发展了140年。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: If is concerned with the people of Africa, the Americas, Asia, the Pacific and parts of Europe.
sentences.zh: 如果关心的是非洲、美洲、亚洲、太平洋和欧洲部分地区的人民。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: While this includes complex kingdoms, as in Africa, and ancient empires, such as those of the Americas, the primary focus of attention in the twentieth century has been on small-scale societies.
sentences.zh: 虽然这包括复杂的王国,如非洲,以及古代帝国,如美洲的帝国,但二十世纪的主要关注焦点一直是小规模社会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Through its collections, the Department’s specific interest is to document how objects are created and used, and to understand their importance and significance to those who produce them.
sentences.zh: 新闻部特别关心的是通过收藏来记录如何创造和使用物品,并了解对制作物品者的重要性和意义。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Such objects can include both the extraordinary and the mundane, the beautiful and the banal.
sentences.zh: 此类物体既包括非同寻常的物体,也包括普通的物体、美丽的物体和平庸的物体。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The collections of the Department of Ethnography include approximately 300,000 artefacts, of which about half are the product of the present century.
sentences.zh: 民族学部收藏的物品约有30万件,其中约一半是本世纪的产物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The Department has a vital role to play in providing information on non-Western cultures to visitors and scholars.
sentences.zh: 新闻部在向来访者和学者提供关于非西方文化的信息方面可以发挥重要作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: To this end, the collecting emphasis has often been less on individual objects than on groups of material which allow the display of a broad range of a society’s cultural expressions.
sentences.zh: 为此,收集重点往往不那么强调个别物体,而强调能够展示社会各种文化表现形式的材料群体。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Much of the more recent collecting was carried out in the field, sometimes by Museum staff working on general anthropological projects in collaboration with a wide variety of national governments and other institutions.
sentences.zh: 最近收集的大部分资料是在外地进行的,有时是由博物馆工作人员与各种各样的国家政府和其他机构合作,从事一般人类学项目。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The material collected includes great technical series – for instance, of textiles from Bolivia, Guatemala, Indonesia and areas of West Africa – or of artefact types such as boats.
sentences.zh: 收集的材料包括大量技术系列,例如玻利维亚、危地马拉、印度尼西亚和西非地区的纺织品,或船只等精品。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The latter include working examples of coracles from India, reed boars from Lake Titicaca in the Andes, kayaks from the Arctic, and dug-out canoes from several countries.
sentences.zh: 后者包括印度的铁丝网、安第斯山脉的提喀卡湖的松木马、北极的皮艇和几个国家的挖出独木舟等工作实例。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The field assemblages, such as those from the Sudan, Madagascar and Yemen, include a whole range of material culture representative of one people.
sentences.zh: 实地各种团体,例如苏丹、马达加斯加和也门的团体,包括代表一个民族的各种物质文化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This might cover the necessities of life of an African herdsman or on Arabian farmer, ritual objects, or even on occasion airport art.
sentences.zh: 这可以包括非洲牧民或阿拉伯农民的生活必需品、仪式物品,甚至有时甚至机场艺术。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Again, a series of acquisitions might represent a decade’s fieldwork documenting social experience as expressed in the varieties of clothing and jewellery styles, tents and camel trappings from various Middle Eastern countries, or in the developing preferences in personal adornment and dress from Papua New Guinea.
sentences.zh: 一系列收购可能再次代表了十年来实地工作记录的社会经验,这些经验表现在中东各国各种服装和珠宝风格、帐篷和骆驼陷阱,或巴布亚新几内亚正在发展的个人服装和服装优惠。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Particularly interesting are a series of collections which continue to document the evolution of ceremony and of material forms for which the Department already possesses early (if nor the earliest) collections formed after the first contact with Europeans.
sentences.zh: 特别令人感兴趣的是,一系列收藏品继续记录仪式和材料形式的演变,新闻部在与欧洲人第一次接触后已经拥有(如果不是最早的话)早期收藏品。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The importance of these acquisitions extends beyond the objects themselves.
sentences.zh: 这些获取的重要性超越了目标本身。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They come from the Museum with documentation of the social context, ideally including photographic records.
sentences.zh: 他们来自博物馆,有社会背景文献,最好包括照片记录。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Such acquisitions have multiple purposes.
sentences.zh: 这种获取具有多重目的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Most significantly they document for future change.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是,它们记录了未来变化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Most people think of the cultures represented in the collection in terms of the absence of advanced technology.
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为,由于缺乏先进技术,收集中体现的文化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In fact, traditional practices draw on a continuing wealth of technological ingenuity.
sentences.zh: 事实上,传统习俗利用了不断丰富的技术才智。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Limited resources and ecological constraints are often overcome by personal skills that would be regarded as exceptional in the West.
sentences.zh: 有限的资源和生态制约往往通过个人技能来克服,而个人技能在西方被认为是例外。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Of growing interest is the way in which much of what we might see as disposable is, elsewhere, recycled and reused.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人感兴趣的是,在其他地方,我们可能认为可以支配的多数东西是如何被再循环和再利用的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: With the Independence of much of Asia and Africa after 1945, it was assumed that economic progress would rapidly lead to the disappearance or assimilation of many small-scale societies.
sentences.zh: 随着1945年亚洲和非洲大部分地区独立后,人们假定,经济进步将迅速导致许多小规模社会消失或同化。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Therefore, it was felt that the Museum should acquire materials representing people whose art or material culture, ritual or political structures were on the point of irrevocable change.
sentences.zh: 因此,人们认为博物馆应获得代表那些艺术或物质文化、仪式或政治结构处于不可改变变化点的人的材料。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: This attitude altered with the realisation that marginal communities can survive and adapt in spite of partial integration into a notoriously fickle world economy.
sentences.zh: 这种态度随着认识到边缘社区尽管部分融入臭名昭著的动荡世界经济,但仍能够生存和适应,从而改变了这种态度。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Since the seventeenth century, with the advent of trading companies exporting manufactured textiles to North America and Asia, the importation of cheap goods has often contributed to the destruction of local skills and indigenous markets.
sentences.zh: 自十七世纪以来,随着贸易公司向北美和亚洲出口制成品纺织品,廉价商品的进口往往助长了当地技能和土著市场的破坏。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: On the one hand modern imported goods may be used in an everyday setting, while on the other hand other traditional objects may still be required for ritually significant events.
sentences.zh: 一方面,现代进口货物可以用于日常生活,另一方面,在仪式上的重大事件仍可能需要其他传统物品。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Within this context trade and exchange attitudes are inverted.
sentences.zh: 在这一背景下,贸易和交流态度被颠倒。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: What are utilitarian objects to a Westerner may be prized objects in other cultures – when transformed by local ingenuity – principally for aesthetic value.
sentences.zh: 西方人拥有的实用物体,在其它文化中,如果由本地的智慧改变,则可能被其他文化所珍视的物体,主要是为了美学价值。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In the some way, the West imports goods from other peoples and in certain circumstances categorizes them as ‘art’.
sentences.zh: 西方从其他民族进口货物, 在某些情况下,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

words.def: 人民人民人民人民人民人民人民人民

sentences.en: Collections act as an ever-expanding database, nor merely for scholars and anthropologists, bur for people involved in a whole range of educational and artistic purposes.
sentences.zh: 收藏品不仅对学者和人类学家来说,而且对从事各种教育和艺术目的的人来说,是一个不断扩大的数据库。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: These include schools and universities as well as colleges of art and design.
sentences.zh: 其中包括学校和大学以及艺术学院和设计学院。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The provision of information about non-Western aesthetics and techniques, not just for designers and artists but for all visitors, is a growing responsibility for a Department whose own context is an increasingly multicultural European society.
sentences.zh: 不仅为设计者和艺术家,而且为所有来访者提供有关非西方美学和技术的信息,对于一个其背景日益成为多文化的欧洲社会的一个部门来说,这种信息越来越成为一项责任。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

items.prompt: The twentieth-century collections come mainly from mainstream societies such as the US and Europe.
The Department of Ethnography focuses mainly on modern societies.
The Department concentrates on collecting single unrelated objects of great value.
The textile collection of the Department of Ethnography is the largest in the world.
Traditional societies are highly inventive in terms of technology.
Many small-scale societies have survived and adapted in spite of predictions to the contrary.
